component.name: 4KWALL
component.summary: Set 4K, HD and live wallpapers for your desktop background

description.p: 4kWall is a fast wallpaper manager and changer for Linux. Browse, download, and set stunning 4K, UHD, and HD wallpapers as your desktop background in a single click, with thousands of high-resolution images to choose from.

ul.li: Browse Millions of Wallpapers: Explore a huge collection of stunning HD, 4K and 8K wallpapers from the internet
High-Quality Wallpaper Downloads: Download wallpapers in their original full resolution
One-Click Wallpaper Setting: Apply any wallpaper to your desktop instantly
Auto Wallpaper Changer: Automatically rotate your wallpaper at your preferred interval
Different Wallpaper Per Monitor: Set a unique wallpaper on each connected monitor
Smart Search and Color Filters: Find wallpapers by keyword, resolution, category, ratio and color
Favourite Collections: Organize your favourite wallpapers into custom collections
Supports HD, 4K and 8K Displays: Optimized for high-resolution and ultrawide monitors
System Tray Integration: Change wallpapers quickly without leaving your workflow
Clean, Modern Dark UI: A polished, distraction-free interface built for your desktop
Regular Wallpaper Library Updates: Discover fresh wallpapers added regularly
Millions of high-quality HD, 4K and 8K wallpapers
Powerful wallpaper search with color filtering
Regular updates with new wallpapers and features

description.p: Wallpaper not applying for some distros - fixed
1. Explore page is much faster and smoother: scrolling no longer jumps, flickers or stutters.
2. Wallpaper feeds are now cached, so Trending, Latest and Viral open instantly instead of reloading every time.
3. Added search history: click the search box to see recent searches, and remove them individually or all at once.
4. A search with no exact match now shows related wallpapers instead of an empty page.
5. Viewer can be resized, remembers its size, opens maximized, and remembers if you left it fullscreen.
6. Viewer: next and previous now work while an image is still loading, and wallpaper tags are shown and can be clicked to search.
7. Auto wallpaper changer can now rotate your Favorites or any folder on your computer, not just downloads.
8. Auto wallpaper changer: the preview updates as soon as you pick a source, and a 10 second interval was added.
9. Added proxy support (HTTP and SOCKS5) for networks where the wallpaper service is not reachable directly.
10. Grid size can now be set separately for Explore, Favorites and Downloads, including a new 6x6 layout.
11. Added a Set as wallpaper button on downloaded favorites.
12. Fixed dragging the viewer and dialog windows on Wayland.
13. Fixed a stuck resize cursor, several freezes, and thumbnails failing to load from some servers.
